title: Sidelink communication transmission reference cell selection

entities.name: UE capable of NR sidelink communication
entities.description: A UE that is capable of NR sidelink communication and configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: Primary frequency condition
entities.description: Condition where the frequency used to transmit NR sidelink communication concerns the primary frequency.

entities.name: Secondary frequency condition
entities.description: Condition where the frequency used to transmit NR sidelink communication concerns a secondary frequency.

entities.name: In coverage condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE is in coverage of the concerned frequency for NR sidelink communication transmission.

entities.name: Out of coverage condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE is out of coverage on the concerned frequency for NR sidelink communication transmission.

entities.name: PCell or serving cell as reference
entities.description: Property where the UE uses the PCell or serving cell as reference for synchronization in NR sidelink communication transmission.

entities.name: SCell as reference
entities.description: Property where the UE uses the concerned SCell as reference for synchronization in NR sidelink communication transmission.

entities.name: DL frequency paired reference
entities.description: Property where the UE uses the DL frequency paired with the one used to transmit NR sidelink communication as reference for synchronization.

relations.description: The UE capable of NR sidelink communication is guarded by the primary frequency condition for reference cell selection.
When the primary frequency condition is met, the UE establishes using the PCell or serving cell as reference.
The UE capable of NR sidelink communication is guarded by the secondary frequency condition for reference cell selection.
When the secondary frequency condition is met, the UE establishes using the concerned SCell as reference.
The UE capable of NR sidelink communication is guarded by the in coverage condition for reference cell selection.
When the in coverage condition is met, the UE establishes using the DL frequency paired with the one used to transmit NR sidelink communication as reference.
The UE capable of NR sidelink communication is guarded by the out of coverage condition for reference cell selection.
When the out of coverage condition is met, the UE establishes using the PCell or serving cell as reference, if needed.
